description: Source code for RandomRDD classes in Apache Spark's MLlib, implementing distributed random data generation for RDDs and vectors.

classes.name: RandomRDDPartition
classes.description: Partition class for RandomRDD, holds index, size, generator, and seed.

classes.name: RandomRDD
classes.description: RDD class generating random data points with specified size and partitions.

classes.name: RandomVectorRDD
classes.description: RDD class generating random vectors with specified size, vector size, and partitions.

methods.name: getPartitions
methods.description: Calculates and returns array of partitions for the RDD based on total size and number of partitions.

methods.name: getPointIterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator over random data points for a given partition, resetting RNG seed each time.

methods.name: getVectorIterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator over random vectors for a given partition, resetting RNG seed each time.
